children.zh-CN: 布局内容，可包含 `Layout.Header`、`Layout.Sider`、`Layout.Content`、`Layout.Footer` 或嵌套的 `Layout`。
children.en-US: Content of the layout: `Layout.Header`, `Layout.Sider`, `Layout.Content`, `Layout.Footer` or a nested `Layout`.

className.en-US: Class name of the root element.

hasSider.zh-CN: 表示子元素里有 Sider，一般不用指定。直接子元素中的 Sider 在渲染时即可识别；更深层嵌套的 Sider 在挂载后才登记，服务端渲染时传 true 可避免样式闪动。传 false 不能去掉 Sider 带来的 has-sider 类。
hasSider.en-US: Indicates that a Sider is inside; usually not needed. A direct child Sider is detected during render; a Sider nested deeper registers after mount, so pass true during SSR to avoid a style flash. Passing false cannot remove the has-sider class that a Sider adds.

ref.zh-CN: 根元素的引用，元素的标签由 `tagName` 决定。
ref.en-US: Reference to the root element, whose tag is set by `tagName`.

tagName.en-US: Tag name of the root element.

aria-label.zh-CN: 侧边栏的可访问名称，描述该 Sider 的作用。
aria-label.en-US: Accessible name of the sider, describing what it is for.

breakpoint.zh-CN: 触发响应式布局的断点，可选 `xs`、`sm`、`md`、`lg`、`xl` 或 `xxl`。仅在挂载时读取一次。
breakpoint.en-US: Breakpoints that trigger the responsive layout: `xs`, `sm`, `md`, `lg`, `xl` or `xxl`. Read once at mount.

children.zh-CN: 侧边栏内容，渲染在根元素内的包裹 `div` 中。
children.en-US: Sider content, rendered inside a `div` wrapped by the root element.

className.en-US: Class name of the root element.

onBreakpoint.zh-CN: 断点命中状态变化时调用，参数为断点名与是否命中。挂载时对 `breakpoint` 中的每个断点按当前视口调用一次，之后在命中或离开时调用。
onBreakpoint.en-US: Called with the breakpoint name and whether it matches: once for each breakpoint in `breakpoint` at mount with the current viewport, then whenever a match starts or stops.
